description.value: Wild Flour Pizza Co is a sourdough-focused pizza restaurant building each 12-inch pie on a naturally leavened crust with creative topping combinations. The Burnaby location is part of a small BC chain that also offers plant-based and gluten-free crust options, making it accessible to cyclists with varied dietary needs. Online ordering is available for convenient pre-ride or post-ride pickup.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms Wild Flour Pizza Co is a multi-location sourdough pizza brand; the Burnaby location at 2900 Bainbridge Ave #104 matches OSM's addr:unit=104 and phone +1-604-238-4346. The menu page explicitly lists plant-based pizzas and a gluten-free crust option, confirming dietary variety. No evidence exists on the website for bike parking, washrooms, water refill, Wi-Fi, or other cyclist-specific amenities.
concerns: OSM community field is 'North Vancouver' but the website and address clearly place this location in Burnaby (2900 Bainbridge Ave #104, Burnaby, BC V5A 2S8). The OSM node may be misassigned to the wrong municipality.
OSM record has no full street address (only addr:unit=104); full address was sourced from the website.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, active pizza restaurant with online ordering and a confirmed Burnaby address; a practical food stop for touring cyclists in the area.

Vegetarian / vegan / GF.detail: Menu page lists a dedicated 'Plant-Based Pizzas' section (Vegan Margherita, Vegan Funghi, Vegan BBQ Jackfruit with cashew mozzarella) and a gluten-free crust modification option
